intro_html: Shawarma spices turn plain chicken into something that smells like a street cart in the best way. This bowl brings 65 grams of protein for about $4.99 (at everyday cost), with a creamy yogurt-tahini sauce that ties it all together. One batch is 14 servings, so you can skip the food-court line for a week and a half.
cost_closing_html: About $4.99 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: You get 65 grams of protein and 585 calories per serving, a big, satisfying bowl for the price.
upsell_html: That sauce alone is worth making a double batch. Trust me on this one. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: A tub of Greek yogurt does double duty as sauce base and protein boost, so one tub covers several recipes before it's gone.
Tahini keeps for months in the pantry, so buy the jar once and a spoonful lifts this sauce for pennies.
Build your own shawarma spice from cumin, paprika, and garlic powder you already have instead of buying a pricey premade blend.
make_it: Add the chicken, olive oil, chicken broth, and garlic to the slow cooker and stir.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours until the chicken is tender and pulls apart easily.
Whisk the Greek yogurt, tahini, and lime juice together to make the drizzle sauce and set it aside.
Steam or roast the broccoli florets while the chicken finishes.
Shred the chicken, pile it over white rice with the broccoli, and spoon the yogurt-tahini sauce on top.
